policy: This file is a scene-to-asset research queue, not an approval manifest. Nothing here is cleared for rendering until a real asset is downloaded, rights metadata is recorded, and human review is complete.

review_flags: avoid implying a specific document says more than it does
verify document provenance and readable date
do not imply present-day buildings are Edo-era
verify surviving garden history before calling it Edo-era
use a sourced schematic; don't invent routes
verify artwork title, creator, and license
split comparison needs two separately reviewed assets; renderer currently accepts one image only
check image license separately from museum website facts
no unverified opening hours, prices, or access claims
do not present the card as an official museum notice

blocking_issues: No media asset is approved by the factual source registry.
Each downloaded asset needs an exact rights statement and rights URL, attribution, retrieval date, SHA-256, dimensions, and human review.
The split_compare scene must not render until the renderer supports two independently validated image assets or the scene is changed to a single-image layout.
The current Tokyo plan is a 48-second editorial draft; final timing must be reconciled with actual Kokoro narration.
